podcast.title: "Female Jerry Lee Lewis"
podcast.body: Laura Lee Perkins was sometimes billed as the "female Jerry Lee Lewis," indicating her energetic piano playing and rock and roll performance style, drawing comparisons to the iconic male artist. "There's Laura Lee Perkins, who was sometimes billed as the female Jerry Lee Lewis."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
